messages:
Anya Patel: FYI — Harrowsys shows ZERO API calls this week. Renewal in ~6 weeks. They were ~20k tokens/day two weeks ago, now flat. Raising a priority flag.
Mike Chen: Ugh — did we lose the champion? I heard their PM left last Friday and procurement paused card billing. Any alerts from infra?
Jordan Rivera: Checked. No 5xx in our logs. Looks like the client switched to a local stub for inference (they told us they were testing offline). We do have some latency spikes reported (~900ms) that could have triggered the rollback. Quick usage query:
```sql
SELECT day, SUM(tokens) FROM usage WHERE account = 'harrowsys' AND day >= '2026-03-01' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC;
```
Jordan Rivera: I'll attach the profile and region heatmap later.
Leo Ford: Marked in Renewal Tracker as "At-Risk — Usage Drop" and added competitor note: Lexa.ai did a demo last Tue (procurement liked their pricing slide). Procurement asked for a TCO comparison.
Anya Patel: Possible root causes: champion exit, procurement hold, performance jitter -> triggered dev rollback. Proposed next steps: 1) quick 1:1 with their new PM to understand stub switch, 2) offer 30k free tokens + a performance tune session, 3) propose a canary reintroduction plan. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 
Mike Chen: Agree. Add SE play — @Jordan can run a perf tune and join the call. @Leo can you prep a one-pager TCO vs Lexa? Also draft an outreach email we can send to their new PM.
Jordan Rivera: I can run a perf profile and capture tail latencies by region — ETA EOD. Also small config suggestion for them to try (prefix caching + batching):
```yaml
inference:
  prefix_cache: true
  batch_size: 8
  quant_profile: fp16
```
Anya Patel: :thumbsup: Scheduling a 15-min sync with their new PM for Thurs (6 days out). Mike — can you loop AE and legal if procurement asks for contract flex?
Mike Chen: On it. AE pinged. Legal FYI: contract has standard 30-day notice but we can propose a 3-month trial amendment if needed. @deploy-bot please update ticket.
deploy-bot: Ticket HS-412 updated to status "triage" by Mike Chen. Risk set to HIGH.
Leo Ford: Added internal notes and uploaded Lexa demo recap. TCO draft link: https://redwood.internal/docs/tco-harrowsys (internal). Will attach procurement questions we saw during the demo.
Anya Patel: Great. Capture action items in the renewal playbook. I'll run the call and push the free tokens + tuning offer on the call. If usage doesn't return in 10 days post-call we'll escalate to CSM lead for exec outreach.
Jordan Rivera: Perf report uploaded: /shared/harrowsys/perf-report.pdf and short how-to for enabling prefix cache attached.
Mike Chen: Thanks — quick win: Jordan, can you also write a 2-step infra note we can send to their infra lead? If it's <200 words we can include in outreach.
Anya Patel: Will do. Closing thread for now — will post updates after the PM sync.
